route: C: geometry-consistent observation-conditioned warm initializer for three-dimensional BOST reconstruction
headline: v98 independently confirms that direct joint 13-dimensional mean, linear ridge and RBF predictors reach at most 75/90 Case 6 cells
headline_zh: v98 独立确认：直接联合 13 维的 mean、linear ridge 与 RBF 小模型最多达到 75/90，均未通过 90/90；下一门转向相机位姿、射线条件化和微分同胚坐标一致性。
next_scientific_gate: freeze a physics-consistent coordinate-change gate before training: verify diffeomorphic invertibility, scalar pullback, inverse-transpose gradient transport, transformed ray/forward/adjoint commutation and leave-one-geometry-out evaluation; only then authorize a small pose- or ray-conditioned sentinel
next_scientific_gate_zh: 先冻结坐标变换物理门：验证微分同胚可逆性、密度标量 pullback、梯度的 Jacobian 逆转置变换、射线/forward/adjoint 的可交换性，并改用 leave-one-geometry-out；这些通过后才训练小型位姿或射线条件化模型。
